rules.name: recon-risk-02-futures-price-fanout
rules.sql: SELECT count(*) AS join_rows, count(DISTINCT s.security_id) AS securities, count(*) - count(DISTINCT s.security_id) AS extra_rows FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s JOIN opera.futures_price_table x ON x.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND x.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id AND x.value_date = s.maturity_date WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = :bu

SELECT x.underlying_id, x.value_date, count(*) AS price_rows, min(x.last_price) AS min_price, max(x.last_price) AS max_price, max(x.updated_timestamp) AS last_updated, max(x.updated_by) AS updated_by FROM opera.futures_price_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = :bu AND s.underlying1_id = x.underlying_id AND s.maturity_date = x.value_date) GROUP BY x.underlying_id, x.value_date HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC, x.value_date DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT count(*) AS securities_without_price FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant AND s.business_unit = :bu AND s.underlying1_id IS NOT NULL AND s.maturity_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.futures_price_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND x.underlying_id = s.underlying1_id AND x.value_date = s.maturity_date)

expect.reason: one price row per security: the rb_fp join does not repeat deals
futures_price_table has one row per tenant, underlying and date for this BU
information only: securities_without_price is a plain count to compare with the previous release
